subject: maths
question: If a right circular cone of height 24 cm has the volume frac{{17600}}{7} cm³, then its radius is:
solution:
Formula used:

Volume of right circular cone = 1over3 × π × r2 × h where,

r = radius of the cone

h = height of the cone

Calculation:

According to the question,

⇒ V = 1over3 × 3.14 × r2 × 24

⇒ r2 = 3 × frac{{17600}}{7} × 1over3.14 times 24 

⇒ r2 = 100 

⇒ r = 10 cm.

∴ The radius of the cone is 10 cm.
